content.title: Macy's stock sees big gains in 2025: A closer look at the retailer
content.description:
Macy's (M) stock is up by over 60% over the last six months. Just what exactly is the retailer doing right in a tight consumer landscape, especially ahead of the start of the holiday shopping season?

Bianco Research President Jim Bianco, Great Hill Capital chairman and managing member Thomas Hayes, and Yahoo Finance senior reporter Brooke DiPalma discuss Macy's execution of its turnaround plan.

Macy's is scheduled to report third quarter earnings on Wednesday, December 3.
